headline: Every bottle of juice checked, not a sample.
label: #F6EFD9
visitLine: Call and visit to Dandenong South
heroLede: This is an example preview for a made-up juice maker. Yours would show your own product, your line and your numbers. Apple, orange and tropical juices share the same bottle, so the wrong label or an old best-before code is easy to miss by eye. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end.
lidLede: The camera checks that every bottle has its cap, that it sits straight and that the fill is at the right height. A loose cap on fresh juice is a short-shelf-life problem waiting in a retailer's fridge.
labelLede: With several flavours on the same bottle, a label left over from the last run is easy to miss. The camera checks every bottle carries the right label, straight and intact.
codeLede: Juice is sold on its best-before date. The system reads the printed code on every bottle and compares it with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Gloves, cloths and small parts can end up near an open conveyor. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there and stops it reaching a case.

vocab.c1h: Caps on, straight and filled to the line
vocab.alert: Four crooked caps in fifteen minutes on Line 1. Check the capper.
